title: MITRE T1566 / T1114.003 Business Email Compromise (BEC) Triage Playbook

steps.activity_name: Validate Suspicious Sign-In & Mailbox Forwarding Alert
steps.description: Verify anomalous IP/ASN sign-ins, impossible travel, or suspicious external forwarding rules.

steps.activity_name: Audit Inbox Manipulation Rules, OAuth Apps & Exchange Connectors
steps.description: Inspect hidden inbox rules moving replies to RSS/Deleted Items and unauthorized mail connectors.

steps.activity_name: Scope Sent-Items Financial Fraud & External Recipient Impact
steps.description: Identify wire-transfer requests, invoice alterations, or phishing emails sent from the compromised mailbox.

steps.activity_name: Revoke Sessions, Reset Credentials & Purge Malicious Rules
steps.description: Conditional containment when mailbox takeover or active fraud is confirmed.
steps.condition: Triggered when preliminary investigation indicators confirm active compromise or operational impact.

steps.activity_name: Notify Finance/Affected Counterparties & Close BEC Case
steps.description: Document fraud prevention status, clean mailbox verification, and closure rationale.
